conditions.description_en: Malaria is a life-threatening disease caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes. In Ethiopia, Plasmodium falciparum and P. vivax are the two main species. Falciparum malaria is the most dangerous and can cause cerebral malaria, severe anemia, and organ failure. Symptoms typically appear 10-15 days after the infective mosquito bite. Malaria is highly seasonal and linked to rainfall patterns. The Ethiopian highlands above 2000m are generally malaria-free, but lowland areas are highly endemic.
conditions.description_am: ወባ በፕላዝሞዲየም ጥገኛ ተሕዋስያን የሚከሰት በተበከለ ሴት አኖፊለስ ትንኝ ንክሻ የሚተላለፍ አደገኛ በሽታ ነው። በኢትዮጵያ ፕላዝሞዲየም ፋልሲፓረም እና ፒ. ቪቫክስ ሁለቱ ዋና ዝርያዎች ናቸው።
conditions.description_ti: ወባ ብፕላዝሞዲዩም ጥረ-ፍጡር ዝፍጠር ብትንኹ ዝመሓላለፍ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Rest in a cool place. Drink plenty of clean fluids to prevent dehydration. Take paracetamol (not aspirin) for fever and pain. Use insecticide-treated bed net. Go to health center immediately for malaria rapid diagnostic test (RDT) and artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT). Do not self-medicate with chloroquine alone as resistance is common.
conditions.self_care_am: ቀዝቃዛ ቦታ ያርፉ። ድርቀትን ለመከላከል ብዙ ንጹህ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። ለትኩሳት ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ (አስፕሪን አይደለም)። ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ብዙሕ ፈሳሲ ስተ፣ ፓራሲታሞል ውሰድ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Sleep under insecticide-treated bed nets (ITNs) every night. Use indoor residual spraying (IRS). Eliminate standing water near homes. Wear long-sleeved clothing at dusk and dawn. Take prophylactic medication if traveling to endemic areas.
conditions.treatment_en: Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) is the first-line treatment. Severe malaria requires IV artesunate in hospital. Primaquine is added for P. vivax to prevent relapse.

emergency_signs_en: breathing rate over 60 per minute in infants
conditions.description_en: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs (alveoli) in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid or pus. It can be caused by bacteria (most commonly Streptococcus pneumoniae), viruses, or fungi. Pneumonia is the leading infectious cause of death in children under 5 worldwide. In Ethiopia, it accounts for a significant proportion of under-5 mortality. Bacterial pneumonia responds to antibiotics; viral pneumonia requires supportive care. Risk factors include malnutrition, indoor air pollution from cooking fires, HIV, and lack of vaccination.
conditions.description_am: የሳምባ ምች በአንድ ወይም በሁለቱም ሳምባዎች ውስጥ ያሉ የአየር ከረጢቶችን የሚያቃጥል ኢንፌክሽን ነው። በባክቴሪያ፣ ቫይረስ ወይም ፈንገስ ሊከሰት ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ሕማም ሳምባ ኣብ ሳምባ ዘሎ ናይ ኣየር ቦርሳ ዘቃጽል ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Seek medical care promptly — do not delay. Keep warm and rest. Drink plenty of fluids. Take prescribed antibiotics for the full course even if feeling better. Use paracetamol for fever. Avoid smoking and indoor smoke. Breastfeed infants. Ensure child is vaccinated with pneumococcal vaccine (PCV).
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ የህክምና እርዳታ ይፈልጉ። ሞቅ ያለ ቦታ ይቆዩ፣ ይረፉ፣ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። የታዘዘውን አንቲባዮቲክ ሙሉ ኮርስ ይውሰዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀልጢፍካ ሕክምና ደሊ። ሞቕ ዝበለ ቦታ ኩን፣ ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ፈሳሲ ስተ።
conditions.prevention_en: Vaccinate children with PCV13 and Hib vaccines. Ensure adequate nutrition. Reduce indoor air pollution. Breastfeed exclusively for 6 months. Treat HIV and malnutrition promptly.
conditions.treatment_en: Amoxicillin is first-line for community-acquired pneumonia. Severe cases require hospitalization with IV antibiotics. Oxygen therapy for hypoxia. Supportive care including fluids and fever management.

emergency_signs_en: severe dehydration (sunken eyes, dry mouth, no tears)
more than 10 watery stools per day
conditions.description_en: Diarrhea is defined as passing 3 or more loose or liquid stools per day. Acute diarrhea is usually caused by viral (rotavirus, norovirus), bacterial (E. coli, Salmonella, Shigella, Vibrio cholerae), or parasitic (Giardia, Cryptosporidium, Entamoeba) infections. In Ethiopia, diarrheal diseases are a leading cause of death in children under 5. Contaminated water, poor sanitation, and inadequate handwashing are the main risk factors. Dehydration is the most dangerous complication, especially in young children and the elderly.
conditions.description_am: ተቅማጥ በቀን ከሶስት ጊዜ በላይ የሚከሰት ልቅ፣ ውሃ ያለው ሰገራ ነው። ብዙ ጊዜ በቫይረስ፣ ባክቴሪያ ወይም ጥገኛ ተሕዋስያን ይከሰታል።
conditions.description_ti: ተምሲ ኣብ መዓልቲ ልዕሊ ሰለስተ ጊዜ ዝኸውን ፈሳሲ ሰገራ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Start oral rehydration solution (ORS) immediately — mix 1 liter clean water with 6 teaspoons sugar and half teaspoon salt, or use pre-packaged ORS sachets. Give small sips frequently. Continue breastfeeding infants. Eat bland foods like rice, bananas, boiled potatoes. Wash hands thoroughly. Visit health center if child under 5, elderly, blood in stool, or no improvement in 2 days.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ORS ይጀምሩ — 1 ሊትር ንጹህ ውሃ ከ6 ሻይ ማንኪያ ስኳር እና ግማሽ ሻይ ማንኪያ ጨው ጋር ይቀላቅሉ። ትንሽ ትንሽ ብዙ ጊዜ ይጠጡ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ORS ወይ ጽሩይ ማይ ምስ ሽኮር ጨውን ስተ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Drink only boiled or treated water. Wash hands with soap before eating and after toilet. Use latrines. Vaccinate children against rotavirus. Breastfeed exclusively for 6 months. Store food safely.
conditions.treatment_en: ORS for mild-moderate dehydration. IV fluids (Ringer's lactate) for severe dehydration. Zinc supplementation for children under 5 (20mg/day for 10-14 days). Antibiotics only for specific bacterial causes (Shigella, cholera). Antiparasitic drugs for Giardia/Entamoeba.

emergency_signs_en: coughing up large amounts of blood
conditions.description_en: Tuberculosis (TB) is caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria. It primarily affects the lungs (pulmonary TB) but can affect any organ (extrapulmonary TB). TB spreads through the air when infected people cough, sneeze, or spit. Ethiopia has one of the highest TB burdens in Africa. TB is curable with a 6-month course of antibiotics. Drug-resistant TB (MDR-TB and XDR-TB) is an emerging concern. HIV co-infection dramatically increases TB risk. TB in children often presents differently — with failure to thrive, lymph node swelling, and less cough.
conditions.description_am: ሳንባ ነቀርሳ በዋናነት ሳምባዎችን የሚጎዳ የባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ሲያስሉ፣ ሲያስነጥሱ ወይም ሲተፉ ወደ አየር ይሰራጫል። ኢትዮጵያ ከፍተኛ የሳንባ ነቀርሳ ጫና ካለባቸው አገሮች አንዷ ነች።
conditions.description_ti: ሳምባ ነቀርሳ ብዋናነት ሳምባ ዝጎድእ ናይ ባክቴርያ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Visit health center immediately for sputum test and chest X-ray. If diagnosed, complete the full 6-month DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment Short-course) regimen without interruption. Cover mouth when coughing. Ventilate living spaces. Eat nutritious food to support recovery. Inform close contacts to get tested.
conditions.self_care_am: ለሳንባ ነቀርሳ ምርመራ ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ሙሉ 6 ወር ህክምና ሳያቋርጡ ይውሰዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀልጢፍካ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ። ሳምባ ነቀርሳ ብምሉእ ሕክምና ይፍወስ።
conditions.prevention_en: BCG vaccination at birth. Early diagnosis and treatment. Ventilate homes. HIV testing and ART for HIV-positive individuals. Contact tracing. Nutritional support.
conditions.treatment_en: Standard 6-month DOTS regimen: 2 months HRZE (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) followed by 4 months HR. MDR-TB requires 18-24 months of second-line drugs. All TB treatment is free in Ethiopia.

emergency_signs_en: high fever above 40C unresponsive to paracetamol
conditions.description_en: Typhoid fever is caused by Salmonella typhi bacteria, spread through contaminated food and water. It is endemic in Ethiopia, particularly in areas with poor sanitation. The fever typically rises gradually over several days and can reach 40C. Without treatment, complications including intestinal perforation (a surgical emergency) can occur in the 3rd week. Paratyphoid fever (Salmonella paratyphi) causes a similar but milder illness.
conditions.description_am: ታይፎይድ ትኩሳት በሳልሞኔላ ታይፊ ባክቴሪያ የሚከሰት ሲሆን በተበከለ ምግብ እና ውሃ ይተላለፋል። ትኩሳቱ ቀስ ብሎ ይጨምራል።
conditions.description_ti: ታይፎይድ ብዝተበከለ ምግብን ማይን ዝመሓላለፍ ናይ ባክቴርያ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Drink only boiled or treated water. Rest and take paracetamol for fever. Eat soft, easily digestible foods. Visit health center for blood culture or Widal test and antibiotic treatment. Complete the full antibiotic course. Isolate patient to prevent spread.
conditions.self_care_am: ንጹህ ውሃ ብቻ ይጠጡ። ይረፉ እና ለትኩሳት ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ጽሩይ ማይ ጥራይ ስተ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Drink safe water. Wash hands before eating and after toilet. Eat properly cooked food. Typhoid vaccine available for high-risk individuals. Proper sewage disposal.
conditions.treatment_en: Azithromycin or fluoroquinolones (ciprofloxacin) are first-line. Ceftriaxone for severe cases. Dexamethasone for severe typhoid with altered consciousness. Surgery for intestinal perforation.

emergency_signs_en: chest pain with shortness of breath
sudden weakness or numbness on one side
conditions.description_en: Hypertension is defined as persistently elevated blood pressure of 140/90 mmHg or higher. It is a major risk factor for heart attack, stroke, kidney failure, and blindness. Often called the 'silent killer' because it usually has no symptoms until complications occur. In Ethiopia, hypertension prevalence is rising due to urbanization, dietary changes, and physical inactivity. Stage 1: 130-139/80-89 mmHg. Stage 2: 140+/90+ mmHg. Hypertensive crisis: above 180/120 mmHg.
conditions.description_am: ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ወደ ልብ ህመም፣ ስትሮክ፣ የኩላሊት ውድቀት እና ዕይታ ማጣት ሊያመራ የሚችል ቋሚ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት ነው። ብዙ ጊዜ ምልክት አይኖረውም።
conditions.description_ti: ልዑል ጸቕጢ ደም ናብ ሕማም ልቢ ዘምርሕ ቀጻሊ ልዑል ጸቕጢ ደም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Reduce salt intake to less than 5g per day. Exercise at least 30 minutes most days. Maintain healthy weight. Avoid alcohol and tobacco. Manage stress through relaxation. Eat fruits and vegetables. Take prescribed medications daily without skipping. Monitor blood pressure regularly at health center.
conditions.self_care_am: የጨው ፍጆታ ይቀንሱ፣ በየጊዜው ይለማመዱ፣ ጭንቀትን ያስወግዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ጨው ቀንስ፣ ምስ ሓኪም ተወከስ።
conditions.prevention_en: Reduce dietary salt. Regular physical activity. Healthy weight. Limit alcohol. No smoking. Stress management. Regular blood pressure screening from age 18.
conditions.treatment_en: Lifestyle modification first. Medications: ACE inhibitors (enalapril), calcium channel blockers (amlodipine), thiazide diuretics (hydrochlorothiazide), beta-blockers. Most patients need 2+ medications. Treatment is lifelong.

emergency_signs_en: severe acute malnutrition (SAM) with MUAC below 11.5cm
conditions.description_en: Malnutrition encompasses undernutrition (wasting, stunting, underweight, micronutrient deficiencies) and overnutrition. In Ethiopia, chronic malnutrition (stunting) affects about 37% of children under 5. Acute malnutrition includes Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) and Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM). Kwashiorkor (protein deficiency) causes edema and skin changes. Marasmus (calorie deficiency) causes severe wasting. Micronutrient deficiencies (iron, vitamin A, iodine, zinc) are widespread.
conditions.description_am: የምግብ እጥረት ቀጭነት፣ ዝቅተኛ ቁመት፣ ቫይታሚን እጥረትን ያካትታል። በኢትዮጵያ ከ5 ዓመት በታች ህጻናት ወደ 37% ሥር የሰደደ የምግብ እጥረት አለባቸው።
conditions.description_ti: ሕጽረት ምግቢ ካብ ዘይምምጣን ዝፍጠር ኩነታት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Eat a balanced diet including proteins (meat, eggs, beans, lentils), carbohydrates (teff, maize, sorghum), fats, and vegetables. Breastfeed infants exclusively for 6 months. Give vitamin A supplements to children 6-59 months. Use iodized salt. Visit health center for MUAC measurement and nutritional assessment. Therapeutic feeding programs available at health centers.
conditions.self_care_am: ፕሮቲን፣ አትክልት እና እህሎች ያሉት ሚዛናዊ ምግብ ይብሉ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዝተመጣጠነ ምግቢ ብላዕ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Exclusive breastfeeding for 6 months. Complementary feeding from 6 months. Vitamin A supplementation. Deworming. Iodized salt. Food security programs. Growth monitoring.
conditions.treatment_en: SAM: F-75 therapeutic milk then F-100 or RUTF (ready-to-use therapeutic food). MAM: supplementary feeding with RUSF. Treat underlying infections. Micronutrient supplementation.

emergency_signs_en: high fever above 39C lasting more than 5 days
conditions.description_en: Upper respiratory infections (URIs) are the most common acute illnesses worldwide. They include the common cold (rhinovirus, coronavirus, adenovirus) and influenza (flu). URIs are spread by droplets and contact with contaminated surfaces. Most resolve within 7-10 days without treatment. Influenza can cause more severe illness, especially in the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Antibiotics are NOT effective against viral URIs.
conditions.description_am: የላይኛው የመተንፈሻ ቱቦ ኢንፌክሽን ብዙ ጊዜ በቫይረስ ይከሰታል። ብዙ ጊዜ በ7-10 ቀናት ውስጥ ይድናል። አንቲባዮቲክ አያስፈልግም።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ላዕሊ ናይ ምስትንፋስ ቱቦ ናይ ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Rest and drink plenty of warm fluids (water, herbal tea, soup). Steam inhalation for nasal congestion. Honey and lemon for sore throat (not for children under 1 year). Paracetamol or ibuprofen for fever and pain. Saline nasal drops. Wash hands frequently. Do NOT take antibiotics — they don't work against viruses. See doctor if symptoms worsen or last more than 10 days.
conditions.self_care_am: ይረፉ፣ ሞቅ ያለ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። ለትኩሳት ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ። እጅዎን ብዙ ጊዜ ይታጠቡ። አንቲባዮቲክ አይጠቀሙ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ሞቕ ዝበለ ፈሳሲ ስተ። ፓራሲታሞል ውሰድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Wash hands frequently. Avoid close contact with sick people. Cover mouth when coughing. Annual influenza vaccine for high-risk groups. Adequate nutrition and sleep.
conditions.treatment_en: Supportive care only for most URIs. Oseltamivir (Tamiflu) for influenza within 48 hours of symptom onset in high-risk patients. Antibiotics only if secondary bacterial infection confirmed.

conditions.description_en: Anemia is a condition where the blood lacks enough healthy red blood cells or hemoglobin to carry adequate oxygen to tissues. In Ethiopia, anemia affects about 23% of adults and over 40% of children under 5 and pregnant women. Iron deficiency is the most common cause, followed by malaria, hookworm infection, vitamin B12/folate deficiency, and sickle cell disease. Hemoglobin below 12 g/dL in women and below 13 g/dL in men indicates anemia. Severe anemia (Hb below 7 g/dL) requires urgent treatment.
conditions.description_am: የደም ማነስ ደም በቂ ጤናማ ቀይ የደም ሴሎች ወይም ሄሞግሎቢን የሌለው ሁኔታ ነው። በኢትዮጵያ ሴቶች እና ህጻናት ዘንድ የተለመደ ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ሕጽረት ደም ዝኣክል ጥዑይ ቀይሕ ደም ዘይምህላው እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Eat iron-rich foods: red meat, liver, fish, eggs, beans, lentils, dark leafy greens (spinach, kale), fortified cereals. Eat vitamin C-rich foods (tomatoes, oranges) with iron-rich foods to improve absorption. Avoid tea and coffee with meals (they reduce iron absorption). Deworm regularly. Visit health center for blood test (hemoglobin measurement) and iron supplements.
conditions.self_care_am: ብረት የበዛባቸው ምግቦችን ይብሉ (ስጋ፣ ባቄላ፣ አረንጓዴ ቅጠሎች)። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ብዙሕ ሓጺን ዘለዎ ምግቢ ብላዕ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Iron and folic acid supplementation for pregnant women. Vitamin A supplementation for children. Deworming every 6 months. Malaria prevention. Fortified foods. Delayed cord clamping at birth.
conditions.treatment_en: Iron supplementation (ferrous sulfate 200mg twice daily for adults). Folic acid for folate deficiency. Vitamin B12 injections for B12 deficiency. Treat underlying cause (malaria, hookworm). Blood transfusion for severe anemia.

symptoms: swollen face and hands in pregnancy
emergency_signs_en: heavy vaginal bleeding (soaking more than 1 pad per hour)
obstructed labor (no progress after 2 hours pushing)
fever with foul-smelling discharge after delivery
conditions.description_en: Obstetric emergencies are the leading cause of maternal death in Ethiopia. The main causes are: postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) — excessive bleeding after delivery; eclampsia — seizures due to high blood pressure in pregnancy; obstructed labor — baby cannot pass through birth canal; sepsis — infection after delivery; unsafe abortion complications. Ethiopia has one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the world. Most deaths are preventable with skilled birth attendance and emergency obstetric care.
conditions.description_am: የወሊድ አደጋዎች ከፍተኛ ደም መፍሰስ፣ ኤክላምፕሲያ እና የተዘጋ ወሊድ ያካትታሉ። ኢትዮጵያ ከፍተኛ የእናቶች ሞት ካለባቸው አገሮች አንዷ ነች።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ሕርሲ ህጹጽ ኩነታት ብዙሕ ደም ምፍሳስ፣ ኤክላምፕሲያ ይጥርዑ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY — do not wait. Call for emergency transport. For heavy bleeding: lie down, elevate legs, apply pressure. For convulsions: protect from injury, turn on side, do not put anything in mouth. For obstructed labor: do not push forcefully. Every minute counts — maternal death can occur within 2 hours of heavy bleeding.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ለአስቸኳይ ትራንስፖርት ይደውሉ። አይዘገዩ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ። ኣይትዘግይ።
conditions.prevention_en: At least 4 antenatal care visits. Skilled birth attendance. Deliver at health facility. Iron and folic acid supplementation. Blood pressure monitoring in pregnancy. Misoprostol for PPH prevention. Birth preparedness plan.
conditions.treatment_en: PPH: oxytocin, misoprostol, manual removal of placenta, uterine massage, blood transfusion, surgery. Eclampsia: magnesium sulfate, antihypertensives, emergency delivery. Obstructed labor: cesarean section. Sepsis: IV antibiotics.

emergency_signs_en: severe opportunistic infection (PCP pneumonia, cryptococcal meningitis)
conditions.description_en: HIV (Human Immunodeficiency Virus) attacks the immune system, specifically CD4+ T cells. Without treatment, HIV progresses to AIDS (Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome) over 8-10 years. AIDS is defined by CD4 count below 200 cells/mm3 or presence of AIDS-defining illnesses. Ethiopia has an HIV prevalence of about 0.9% in adults. Antiretroviral therapy (ART) allows people with HIV to live long, healthy lives and prevents transmission. HIV is transmitted through unprotected sex, sharing needles, blood transfusion, and mother-to-child transmission.
conditions.description_am: ኤች አይ ቪ የበሽታ መከላከያ ስርዓቱን ያዳክማል። ቀደምት ምርመራ እና ህክምና ጤናማ ህይወት ያስችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ኤች ኣይ ቪ ናይ ሕማም ምክልኻል ስርዓት ዘዳኽም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Get tested at health center — HIV testing is free and confidential. If positive, start ART immediately regardless of CD4 count (Test and Treat). Take ART every day without missing doses. Use condoms consistently to prevent transmission. Eat nutritious food. Avoid alcohol and smoking. Attend regular follow-up appointments. Pregnant women with HIV must take ART to prevent mother-to-child transmission.
conditions.self_care_am: በጤና ጣቢያ ይመርምሩ። ፖዘቲቭ ከሆኑ ወዲያውኑ ART ይጀምሩ። ስርጭትን ለመከላከል ኮንዶም ይጠቀሙ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ኣብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ምርመራ ግበር። ፖዘቲቭ እንተኾይንካ ART ጀምር።
conditions.prevention_en: Consistent condom use. HIV testing and counseling. ART for HIV-positive individuals (Treatment as Prevention). PMTCT (Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission). Safe blood transfusion. Needle exchange programs. PrEP for high-risk individuals.
conditions.treatment_en: First-line ART: TDF + 3TC + DTG (tenofovir, lamivudine, dolutegravir). ART is free in Ethiopia. Regular CD4 count and viral load monitoring. Cotrimoxazole prophylaxis for CD4 below 200. Treatment of opportunistic infections.

emergency_signs_en: severe dehydration (sunken eyes, no skin turgor)
shock (rapid weak pulse, low blood pressure)
conditions.description_en: Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae bacteria, spread through contaminated water and food. It causes profuse watery diarrhea that can lead to severe dehydration and death within hours if untreated. Cholera outbreaks occur in Ethiopia, particularly after floods and in areas with poor sanitation. The incubation period is 2 hours to 5 days. Cholera is a notifiable disease — outbreaks must be reported to health authorities immediately.
conditions.description_am: ኮሌራ ከፍተኛ ተቅማጥ እና ድርቀት የሚያስከትል ከፍተኛ የባክቴሪያ ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ሳይታከም ቢቀር በሰዓታት ውስጥ ሊገድል ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ኮሌራ ብዙሕ ተምሲን ምድረቕን ዘስዕብ ናይ ባክቴርያ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HEALTH CENTER IMMEDIATELY — cholera can kill within hours. Start ORS immediately while arranging transport. Give large amounts of ORS — up to 1 liter per hour for adults. Isolate patient to prevent spread. Disinfect all surfaces with chlorine solution. Report to health authorities. Do not prepare food for others.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ORS ያለማቋረጥ ይጠጡ። ስርጭትን ለመከላከል ታካሚውን ያግሉ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀልጢፍካ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ። ORS ስተ።
conditions.prevention_en: Safe water (boil or chlorinate). Proper sanitation and latrines. Handwashing with soap. Safe food handling. Oral cholera vaccine (OCV) in outbreak areas. Rapid case detection and reporting.
conditions.treatment_en: ORS for mild-moderate dehydration. IV Ringer's lactate for severe dehydration (100ml/kg over 3 hours). Doxycycline or azithromycin to shorten illness duration. Zinc for children. Strict isolation and infection control.

symptoms: rash starting on face spreading downward
conditions.description_en: Measles is caused by the measles virus and is one of the most contagious infectious diseases known. One infected person can infect 12-18 others. It spreads through respiratory droplets. The rash appears 3-5 days after fever onset, starting on the face and spreading downward. Complications include pneumonia (leading cause of measles death), encephalitis, blindness, and severe diarrhea. Measles is preventable by vaccination (2 doses of MMR vaccine). Vitamin A deficiency increases measles severity.
conditions.description_am: ኩፍኝ በጣም ተላላፊ የቫይረስ በሽታ ነው። ክትባት ሊከላከለው ይችላል። ቫይታሚን A እጥረት ኩፍኝን ያባብሳል።
conditions.description_ti: ኩፍኝ ብዙሕ ዝመሓላለፍ ናይ ቫይረስ ሕማም እዩ። ብክታበት ይከላኸል።
conditions.self_care_en: Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Take paracetamol for fever. Give vitamin A supplements (200,000 IU for children over 1 year, 100,000 IU for 6-12 months). Isolate patient for 4 days after rash onset. Visit health center for assessment and vitamin A. Keep eyes clean. Ensure adequate nutrition.
conditions.self_care_am: ይረፉ፣ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ፣ ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ስርጭትን ለመከላከል ያግሉ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ፈሳሲ ስተ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Two doses of measles vaccine (at 9 months and 15-18 months in Ethiopia). Maintain vaccination coverage above 95% for herd immunity. Vitamin A supplementation. Rapid response to outbreaks.
conditions.treatment_en: Supportive care. Vitamin A supplementation (reduces mortality by 50%). Antibiotics for secondary bacterial infections. Hospitalization for severe cases.

emergency_signs_en: very high blood sugar above 20 mmol/L (hyperglycemia)
very low blood sugar below 3 mmol/L (hypoglycemia — sweating, shaking, confusion)
conditions.description_en: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disease characterized by elevated blood glucose. Type 1 diabetes: autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing cells, requires insulin injections. Type 2 diabetes: insulin resistance and relative insulin deficiency, managed with lifestyle changes and oral medications. Gestational diabetes occurs during pregnancy. In Ethiopia, diabetes prevalence is rising, particularly in urban areas. Complications include cardiovascular disease, kidney failure, blindness (diabetic retinopathy), nerve damage (neuropathy), and foot ulcers.
conditions.description_am: የስኳር በሽታ ሰውነት የደም ስኳር መጠንን በትክክል መቆጣጠር የማይችልበት ሥር የሰደደ ሁኔታ ነው። ዓይነት 1 እና ዓይነት 2 ዓይነቶች አሉ።
conditions.description_ti: ሕማም ሽኮር ኣካላት ሽኮር ደም ብቕኑዕ ክቆጻጸር ዘይክእለሉ ኩነታት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Reduce sugar, white bread, white rice, and processed food intake. Eat more vegetables, whole grains, and legumes. Exercise at least 30 minutes daily. Maintain healthy weight. Monitor blood sugar regularly. Take medications as prescribed without skipping. Check feet daily for wounds. Visit health center for HbA1c test every 3 months. Avoid smoking and alcohol.
conditions.self_care_am: የስኳር እና የተጣራ ካርቦሃይድሬት ፍጆታ ይቀንሱ። በየጊዜው ይለማመዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሽኮር ቀንስ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Healthy diet. Regular physical activity. Maintain healthy weight. Avoid tobacco. Regular blood sugar screening from age 45 or earlier if risk factors present.
conditions.treatment_en: Type 1: Insulin (regular, NPH, or analogues). Type 2: Metformin first-line, then add sulfonylureas, insulin as needed. Blood pressure control. Statin therapy. Annual eye and kidney checks. Foot care.

conditions.description_en: Conjunctivitis (pink eye) is inflammation of the conjunctiva, caused by bacteria (Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, Haemophilus), viruses (adenovirus, herpes), or allergies. Trachoma, caused by Chlamydia trachomatis, is the world's leading infectious cause of blindness and is endemic in Ethiopia. Repeated trachoma infections cause scarring of the eyelid (trichiasis), which scratches the cornea leading to blindness. The SAFE strategy (Surgery, Antibiotics, Facial cleanliness, Environmental improvement) is used to control trachoma.
conditions.description_am: ትራኮማን ጨምሮ የዓይን ኢንፌክሽኖች በኢትዮጵያ የተለመዱ ናቸው። ሳይታከሙ ቢቀሩ ዕይታ ሊያጡ ይችላሉ።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ዓይኒ ኢንፌክሽን ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ልሙድ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Wash face and hands frequently with soap and water. Do not share towels, pillowcases, or eye makeup. Clean eye discharge with clean wet cloth from inner to outer corner. Do not rub eyes. Visit health center for antibiotic eye drops (chloramphenicol or tetracycline). For trachoma: azithromycin oral antibiotic. Protect eyes from flies.
conditions.self_care_am: ፊትዎን እና እጅዎን ብዙ ጊዜ ይታጠቡ። ፎጣ አይጋሩ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ገጽካ ብዙሕ ጊዜ ሕጸብ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Face washing. Fly control. Improved water access and sanitation. Mass drug administration of azithromycin in trachoma-endemic areas. Trichiasis surgery to prevent blindness.
conditions.treatment_en: Bacterial conjunctivitis: chloramphenicol or tetracycline eye drops. Trachoma: azithromycin 1g single dose (or tetracycline eye ointment). Trichiasis: eyelid surgery. Viral conjunctivitis: supportive care.

conditions.description_en: Common skin infections in Ethiopia include: Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei mite) — intense itching especially at night, burrow tracks between fingers; Impetigo (Staphylococcus/Streptococcus) — honey-colored crusted sores; Tinea (ringworm, athlete's foot, jock itch) — fungal infections causing ring-shaped rashes; Cellulitis — bacterial skin infection causing redness, warmth, swelling. Scabies is highly contagious and spreads through close contact and shared bedding.
conditions.description_am: የቆዳ ኢንፌክሽኖች እና ቁርጥማት ውሃ ባነሰ ቦታ ብዙ ሰዎች ሲኖሩ የተለመዱ ናቸው።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ቆርበት ኢንፌክሽን ኣብ ጽቡቕ ማይ ዘይብሉ ቦታ ልሙድ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Keep skin clean and dry. Wash clothes, bedding, and towels in hot water. For scabies: apply permethrin 5% cream from neck down, leave overnight, wash off — treat all household members simultaneously. For fungal infections: keep area dry, apply antifungal cream. Do not share personal items. Visit health center for prescription treatment.
conditions.self_care_am: ቆዳዎን ንጹህ እና ደረቅ ያቆዩ። ልብስ እና አልጋ ሸፈን ይታጠቡ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቆርበትካ ጽሩይን ነቓዕን ኩን። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Regular bathing. Clean water access. Avoid sharing personal items. Treat all household contacts for scabies. Improve housing and sanitation.
conditions.treatment_en: Scabies: permethrin 5% cream or benzyl benzoate. Impetigo: topical mupirocin or oral amoxicillin. Tinea: topical clotrimazole or oral griseofulvin for scalp ringworm. Cellulitis: oral or IV antibiotics.

conditions.description_en: Meningitis is inflammation of the meninges (membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord). Bacterial meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae) is a medical emergency with high mortality if untreated. Viral meningitis is usually less severe. Ethiopia is in the African meningitis belt — epidemic meningococcal meningitis occurs regularly. Cryptococcal meningitis is common in HIV-positive patients. The classic triad is fever, stiff neck, and headache.
conditions.description_am: ሜኒንጃይቲስ የአንጎልን ሽፋን የሚያቃጥል ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ሳይታከም ቢቀር ሊገድል ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ሜኒንጃይቲስ ናይ ሓንጎል ሽፋን ዘቃጽል ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY — bacterial meningitis can kill within 24 hours. Do not wait. Keep patient in quiet, dark room. Do not give aspirin to children. Meningococcal meningitis is contagious — inform health authorities.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ባክቴሪያ ሜኒንጃይቲስ በ24 ሰዓት ውስጥ ሊገድል ይችላል።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Meningococcal vaccine (MenAfriVac in meningitis belt). Pneumococcal vaccine (PCV). Hib vaccine. Chemoprophylaxis for close contacts of meningococcal cases (rifampicin or ciprofloxacin).
conditions.treatment_en: IV ceftriaxone or penicillin G immediately. Dexamethasone to reduce inflammation. Supportive care. Treat HIV-associated cryptococcal meningitis with amphotericin B and fluconazole.

emergency_signs_en: spasms triggered by noise or touch
conditions.description_en: Tetanus is caused by toxin from Clostridium tetani bacteria, which enter through wounds. Neonatal tetanus occurs when the umbilical cord is cut with unsterile instruments. Tetanus causes painful muscle spasms and can be fatal. It is preventable by vaccination. In Ethiopia, neonatal tetanus remains a problem in areas with low vaccination coverage and traditional birth practices.
conditions.description_am: ቴታነስ ቁስሎች ውስጥ ከሚገቡ ባክቴሪያ ጥቃቅን ፍጥረቶች ይከሰታል። ክትባት ሊከላከለው ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ቴታነስ ካብ ቁስሊ ዝኣቱ ባክቴርያ ዝፍጠር እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY. Clean all wounds thoroughly with soap and water. Ensure tetanus vaccination is up to date. For neonatal tetanus: hospital emergency care required. Pregnant women should receive tetanus toxoid vaccine.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ቁስሎችን በሳሙና እና ውሃ ያጽዱ። ክትባት ያረጋግጡ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: DTP vaccination series in childhood. Tetanus booster every 10 years. Tetanus toxoid for pregnant women (2 doses). Clean wound care. Sterile cord cutting at birth.
conditions.treatment_en: Tetanus immunoglobulin (TIG). Metronidazole or penicillin. Diazepam for muscle spasms. Mechanical ventilation if needed. Wound debridement.

emergency_signs_en: any animal bite (dog, cat, monkey, bat)
conditions.description_en: Rabies is a fatal viral disease transmitted through the saliva of infected animals, usually through bites. Dogs are the main source in Ethiopia. Once symptoms appear, rabies is almost always fatal. However, post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) — wound washing plus rabies vaccine — is nearly 100% effective if given promptly after exposure. Ethiopia has one of the highest rabies burdens in Africa. Any animal bite should be treated as a potential rabies exposure.
conditions.description_am: ቁስቁስ ብዙ ጊዜ ከተበከሉ እንስሳት ንክሻ የሚተላለፍ ገዳይ የቫይረስ በሽታ ነው። ምልክቶቹ ከታዩ በኋላ ሊድን አይችልም። ነገር ግን ወዲያውኑ ህክምና ቢወሰድ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ሊከላከል ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ቁስቁስ ካብ ዝተበከሉ እንስሳ ዝመሓላለፍ ናይ ቫይረስ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: IMMEDIATELY after any animal bite: wash wound vigorously with soap and water for at least 15 minutes. Apply iodine or alcohol. Go to health center IMMEDIATELY for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) — do not wait for symptoms. PEP must start within 24-48 hours. Report the biting animal to authorities.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ቁስሉን ቢያንስ ለ15 ደቂቃ በሳሙና እና ውሃ ያጽዱ። ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቁስሊ ቀልጢፍካ ብሳሙና ሕጸብ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Dog vaccination campaigns. Responsible pet ownership. Avoid contact with stray animals. Pre-exposure prophylaxis for high-risk individuals (veterinarians, lab workers). Post-exposure prophylaxis after any bite.
conditions.treatment_en: Post-exposure prophylaxis: wound washing + rabies vaccine (days 0, 3, 7, 14) + rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) for severe exposures. Once symptoms appear, only palliative care is possible.

conditions.description_en: Ethiopia has many venomous snake species including puff adders, cobras, mambas, and vipers. Snakebite is a significant cause of death and disability in rural Ethiopia. Venom types: cytotoxic (tissue destruction, swelling), neurotoxic (paralysis, respiratory failure), hemotoxic (bleeding disorders). Most bites occur on feet and legs during farming activities.
conditions.description_am: ኢትዮጵያ ብዙ መርዛማ እባቦች አሏት። የእባብ ንክሻ በገጠር ኢትዮጵያ ሞት እና አካል ጉዳት ያስከትላል።
conditions.description_ti: ኢትዮጵያ ብዙሕ ናይ ምርዛን ተመናት ኣለዋ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY — antivenom must be given within hours. Keep patient calm and still — movement spreads venom. Immobilize the bitten limb below heart level. Remove tight clothing and jewelry near bite. Do NOT cut the wound, suck out venom, apply tourniquet, or apply ice. Note the snake's appearance if safe to do so.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ታካሚውን ያረጋጉ። የተነከሰውን ክፍለ ሰውነት ያቆዩ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Wear boots and long trousers when farming. Use a torch at night. Clear vegetation around homes. Avoid reaching into holes or under rocks. Sleep on raised beds.
conditions.treatment_en: Polyvalent antivenom IV. Wound care. Tetanus prophylaxis. Supportive care. Mechanical ventilation for respiratory failure. Blood products for coagulopathy.

symptoms: symptoms worse at night or early morning
emergency_signs_en: severe breathlessness unable to speak in full sentences
conditions.description_en: Asthma is a chronic inflammatory disease of the airways causing recurrent episodes of wheezing, breathlessness, chest tightness, and coughing. Triggers include dust, smoke, pollen, cold air, exercise, respiratory infections, and stress. Asthma is not curable but can be well-controlled with proper medication. Indoor air pollution from cooking fires is a major trigger in Ethiopia. Asthma attacks can be life-threatening.
conditions.description_am: አስም የአየር ቱቦዎችን ሥር የሰደደ ኢንፌክሽን ሲሆን ደጋግሞ ሲፏፏ፣ ትንፋሽ ማጠር፣ ሳልን ያስከትላል። ሙሉ ለሙሉ ሊድን ባይችልም ሊቆጣጠር ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ኣዝማ ናይ ኣየር ቱቦ ሥር ዝሰደደ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Identify and avoid triggers (dust, smoke, strong smells, cold air). Use reliever inhaler (salbutamol) during attacks. Use preventer inhaler (beclomethasone) daily if prescribed. Do not smoke indoors. Reduce indoor cooking smoke. Visit health center for diagnosis and inhaler prescription. Have an asthma action plan.
conditions.self_care_am: ቀስቃሾችን ያስወግዱ (አቧራ፣ ጭስ)። ሳልቡታሞል ኢንሃለር ይጠቀሙ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ናይ ኣዝማ ቀስቃሲ ኣወግድ። ሳልቡታሞል ኢንሃለር ተጠቐም።
conditions.prevention_en: Avoid triggers. Reduce indoor air pollution. Treat respiratory infections promptly. Regular use of preventer inhaler. Annual influenza vaccine.
conditions.treatment_en: Reliever: salbutamol (SABA) inhaler. Preventer: inhaled corticosteroids (beclomethasone, budesonide). Severe asthma: oral prednisolone, IV magnesium sulfate, oxygen. Avoid NSAIDs in aspirin-sensitive asthma.

conditions.description_en: Heart failure occurs when the heart cannot pump enough blood to meet the body's needs. Causes in Ethiopia include rheumatic heart disease (most common in young adults), hypertension, cardiomyopathy, and ischemic heart disease. Rheumatic heart disease results from untreated streptococcal throat infections causing permanent heart valve damage. Heart failure is classified as left-sided (pulmonary edema, breathlessness) or right-sided (peripheral edema, ascites).
conditions.description_am: የልብ ውድቀት ልብ ሰውነቱ የሚፈልገውን ደም ማፍሰስ ሲያቅተው ይከሰታል። በኢትዮጵያ ሩማቲካዊ የልብ ህመም ዋና ምክንያት ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ምውዳቕ ልቢ ልቢ ዝኣክል ደም ክፍሰስ ዘይክእለሉ ኩነታት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Take prescribed medications daily (diuretics, ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers). Restrict salt and fluid intake. Weigh yourself daily — report 2kg gain in 2 days to doctor. Elevate legs when sitting. Sleep with head elevated. Avoid strenuous activity. Visit health center regularly. Treat throat infections promptly to prevent rheumatic fever.
conditions.self_care_am: የታዘዙ መድሃኒቶችን ይውሰዱ። ጨው እና ፈሳሽ ፍጆታ ይቀንሱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዝተዓዘዙ መድሃኒታት ውሰድ። ጨው ቀንስ።
conditions.prevention_en: Treat streptococcal throat infections with penicillin. Benzathine penicillin prophylaxis for rheumatic fever. Blood pressure control. Healthy lifestyle.
conditions.treatment_en: Diuretics (furosemide). ACE inhibitors (enalapril). Beta-blockers (carvedilol). Spironolactone. Digoxin for atrial fibrillation. Valve surgery for rheumatic heart disease. Benzathine penicillin prophylaxis.

emergency_signs_en: sudden weakness or numbness of face, arm, or leg on one side
sudden vision problems in one or both eyes
sudden severe headache with no known cause
sudden trouble walking or loss of balance
emergency_signs_am: ድንገተኛ የፊት ወይም የእጅ ወይም የእግር ድክመት
conditions.description_en: A stroke occurs when blood supply to part of the brain is cut off (ischemic stroke — 85%) or when a blood vessel in the brain bursts (hemorrhagic stroke — 15%). Brain cells die within minutes without oxygen. Time is critical — 'Time is Brain.' The FAST acronym: Face drooping, Arm weakness, Speech difficulty, Time to call for help. Hypertension is the leading risk factor. Stroke is increasingly common in Ethiopia due to rising hypertension and diabetes.
conditions.description_am: ስትሮክ ወደ አንጎል የሚሄደው ደም ሲቋረጥ ወይም የደም ቧንቧ ሲፈነዳ ይከሰታል። ጊዜ ወሳኝ ነው — ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ።
conditions.description_ti: ስትሮክ ናብ ሓንጎል ዝኸይድ ደም ክቋረጥ ከሎ ይፍጠር።
conditions.self_care_en: CALL FOR HELP IMMEDIATELY — stroke is a medical emergency. Use FAST: Face drooping? Arm weakness? Speech difficulty? Time to call for help. Do not give food or water (risk of choking). Keep patient lying down with head slightly elevated. Note the time symptoms started — this is critical for treatment decisions.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ እርዳታ ይጠሩ። FAST: ፊት መዝለቅ? የእጅ ድክመት? የንግግር ችግር? ጊዜ ወሳኝ ነው።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ሓገዝ ጸውዕ። ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Control blood pressure. Manage diabetes. Stop smoking. Reduce alcohol. Regular exercise. Healthy diet. Treat atrial fibrillation. Antiplatelet therapy for high-risk patients.
conditions.treatment_en: Ischemic stroke: IV alteplase (tPA) within 4.5 hours if available. Aspirin 300mg. Supportive care. Hemorrhagic stroke: blood pressure control, neurosurgery if indicated. Rehabilitation: physiotherapy, speech therapy.

emergency_signs_en: seizure lasting more than 5 minutes (status epilepticus)
multiple seizures without recovery between them
seizure with fever and stiff neck
emergency_signs_am: ሽብርታ ከትኩሳት እና ጠንካራ አንገት ጋር
conditions.description_en: Epilepsy is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent unprovoked seizures. It affects about 1% of the population. In Ethiopia, epilepsy is often stigmatized and undertreated. Common causes include birth injury, head trauma, meningitis, malaria, neurocysticercosis (tapeworm in brain), and genetic factors. Many people with epilepsy can be seizure-free with proper medication. The treatment gap in Ethiopia is very high — most people with epilepsy do not receive treatment.
conditions.description_am: የሚጥል በሽታ ደጋጋሚ ሽብርታ የሚያስከትል የነርቭ ስርዓት ህመም ነው። ብዙ ሰዎች ህክምና ሳያገኙ ይቀራሉ።
conditions.description_ti: ሕማም ሚጥሊ ደጋጋሚ ምንቅጥቃጥ ዘስዕብ ናይ ነርቭ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: During a seizure: protect from injury (move sharp objects away), turn on side to prevent choking, do not restrain, do not put anything in mouth, time the seizure. After seizure: keep calm, stay with person until fully conscious. Take prescribed antiepileptic medication daily without missing doses. Visit health center for diagnosis and medication. Avoid swimming alone, heights, and open fires.
conditions.self_care_am: ሽብርታ ሲከሰት: ከጉዳት ይጠብቁ፣ ጎን ያዙሩ፣ አፍ ውስጥ ምንም አያስገቡ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ምንቅጥቃጥ ኣብ ዝህሉ: ካብ ጉዳት ሓሉ፣ ናብ ጎኒ ምለስ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Prevent head injuries (helmets). Treat meningitis and malaria promptly. Safe delivery to prevent birth injury. Deworming (neurocysticercosis prevention). Avoid alcohol.
conditions.treatment_en: Phenobarbital (first-line in Ethiopia — cheap and effective). Phenytoin. Carbamazepine. Valproate. Most epilepsy can be controlled with a single medication. Treatment is lifelong for most patients.

conditions.description_en: Depression is a common mental health disorder characterized by persistent low mood, loss of interest, and various physical and psychological symptoms lasting at least 2 weeks. In Ethiopia, depression is common but highly stigmatized and undertreated. It is associated with poverty, food insecurity, HIV, chronic illness, and gender-based violence. Depression is treatable with counseling and/or antidepressant medication. Postpartum depression affects many new mothers.
conditions.description_am: ድብርት ቋሚ ሀዘን፣ ፍላጎት ማጣት እና ሌሎች ምልክቶች ያሉት የአዕምሮ ጤና ህመም ነው። ሊታከም ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ጭንቀት ቀጻሊ ሓዘን ዘስዕብ ናይ ኣእምሮ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Talk to someone you trust about your feelings. Maintain regular sleep schedule. Exercise regularly — even walking helps. Eat regular meals. Avoid alcohol. Engage in social activities. Visit health center or health extension worker for counseling and treatment. Antidepressants are effective and available. You are not alone — depression is a medical condition, not a weakness.
conditions.self_care_am: ለሚያምኑት ሰው ስሜቶቻቸውን ይናገሩ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ድብርት ሊታከም ይችላል።
conditions.self_care_ti: ምስ ትኣምኖ ሰብ ተዛረብ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Social support networks. Stress management. Regular exercise. Adequate sleep. Treat underlying medical conditions. Address poverty and food insecurity.
conditions.treatment_en: Counseling/psychotherapy (cognitive behavioral therapy). Antidepressants: amitriptyline or fluoxetine. Combination therapy most effective. Treat underlying conditions. Social support.

conditions.description_en: Schistosomiasis is caused by parasitic flatworms (Schistosoma mansoni and S. haematobium) that penetrate skin during contact with contaminated freshwater. It is endemic in many parts of Ethiopia, particularly around Lake Tana, the Rift Valley lakes, and irrigation schemes. Chronic infection causes liver fibrosis, portal hypertension, bladder cancer, and kidney damage. It is the second most socioeconomically devastating parasitic disease after malaria.
conditions.description_am: ሺስቶሶሚያሲስ በተበከለ ንጹህ ውሃ ውስጥ ሲዋኙ ቆዳ ውስጥ ከሚገቡ ጥገኛ ተሕዋስያን ይከሰታል።
conditions.description_ti: ሺስቶሶሚያሲስ ኣብ ዝተበከለ ማይ ምስ ዝተጸምቀ ቆርበት ዝኣቱ ጥረ-ፍጡር ዝፍጠር እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Avoid swimming or wading in freshwater lakes, rivers, and irrigation canals in endemic areas. Use safe water for bathing. Visit health center for praziquantel treatment. Mass drug administration programs available in endemic areas.
conditions.self_care_am: በተበከሉ ሀይቆች እና ወንዞች ውስጥ አይዋኙ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ኣብ ዝተበከለ ማይ ኣይትሕምብስ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Avoid contact with contaminated water. Safe water supply. Sanitation improvement. Mass drug administration with praziquantel. Snail control.
conditions.treatment_en: Praziquantel 40mg/kg single dose (or split into 2 doses). Repeat after 6 weeks if needed. Treatment is free in mass drug administration programs.

conditions.description_en: Leishmaniasis is caused by Leishmania parasites transmitted by sandfly bites. Ethiopia has three forms: Visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) — affects internal organs, can be fatal; Cutaneous leishmaniasis — skin ulcers; Mucocutaneous leishmaniasis — destroys nose and mouth tissues. Ethiopia has one of the highest burdens of visceral leishmaniasis in the world, particularly in the lowlands of Tigray, Amhara, and SNNPR. HIV co-infection dramatically worsens outcomes.
conditions.description_am: ሌሽማኒያሲስ በሳንድፍላይ ንክሻ የሚተላለፍ ጥገኛ ተሕዋስያን ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ኢትዮጵያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ካለባቸው አገሮች አንዷ ነች።
conditions.description_ti: ሌሽማኒያሲስ ብሳንድፍላይ ዝመሓላለፍ ጥረ-ፍጡር ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Visit health center immediately for diagnosis (blood test, bone marrow test). Treatment is available free at health centers. Use insect repellent and bed nets to prevent sandfly bites. Avoid sleeping outdoors in endemic areas.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ህክምና ይገኛል።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀልጢፍካ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Insecticide-treated bed nets. Indoor residual spraying. Insect repellent. Avoid outdoor sleeping in endemic areas. Early treatment of cases.
conditions.treatment_en: Visceral: sodium stibogluconate or liposomal amphotericin B or miltefosine. Cutaneous: sodium stibogluconate injections or topical treatment. Treatment is free in Ethiopia.

emergency_signs_en: intestinal obstruction (severe abdominal pain, vomiting, no stool)
conditions.description_en: Intestinal worm infections are extremely common in Ethiopia. Hookworm (Ancylostoma, Necator) penetrates skin from contaminated soil and causes iron deficiency anemia. Roundworm (Ascaris) is the most common — eggs ingested from contaminated food/water. Tapeworm (Taenia) from undercooked beef or pork. Pinworm causes anal itching. Neurocysticercosis (tapeworm larvae in brain) causes seizures. Mass deworming programs target school-age children.
conditions.description_am: የሆድ ትሎች ኢንፌክሽን በኢትዮጵያ በጣም የተለመደ ነው። ሁኩርም ቆዳ ውስጥ ከሚገቡ ትሎች ይከሰታል።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ሆድ ትሎች ኢንፌክሽን ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ልሙድ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Wear shoes to prevent hookworm. Wash hands before eating. Eat well-cooked meat. Drink clean water. Deworm every 6 months with albendazole or mebendazole (available free at health posts). Visit health center if symptoms are severe.
conditions.self_care_am: ጫማ ይልበሱ። ከመብላትዎ በፊት እጅዎን ይታጠቡ። ሥጋ ሙሉ ለሙሉ ያብስሉ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ጫማ ተኸደን። ቅድሚ ምብላዕ ኣእዳውካ ሕጸብ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Wear shoes. Handwashing. Safe water. Cook meat thoroughly. Latrine use. Mass deworming programs. Avoid open defecation.
conditions.treatment_en: Albendazole 400mg single dose or mebendazole 500mg single dose. Repeat after 2 weeks for heavy infections. Iron supplementation for hookworm anemia. Praziquantel for tapeworm.

emergency_signs_en: UTI in men (may indicate prostate problem)
conditions.description_en: UTIs are caused by bacteria (most commonly E. coli) infecting the urinary tract. Lower UTI (cystitis) affects the bladder. Upper UTI (pyelonephritis) affects the kidneys and is more serious. UTIs are much more common in women due to shorter urethra. In pregnancy, UTIs must be treated promptly to prevent preterm birth and kidney infection. Recurrent UTIs may indicate underlying problems.
conditions.description_am: የሽንት ቱቦ ኢንፌክሽን ብዙ ጊዜ ባክቴሪያ ሽንት ቱቦ ውስጥ ሲገቡ ይከሰታል። ሴቶች ዘንድ የተለመደ ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ሽንቲ ቱቦ ኢንፌክሽን ብዙሕ ጊዜ ኣብ ኣንስቲ ዝርአ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Drink plenty of water (at least 8 glasses per day). Urinate frequently — do not hold urine. Wipe front to back after toilet. Visit health center for urine test and antibiotic treatment. Complete the full antibiotic course. Avoid perfumed soaps near genitals.
conditions.self_care_am: ብዙ ውሃ ይጠጡ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ሙሉ አንቲባዮቲክ ኮርስ ይውሰዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ብዙሕ ማይ ስተ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Adequate fluid intake. Urinate after sexual intercourse. Wipe front to back. Avoid holding urine. Treat promptly in pregnancy.
conditions.treatment_en: Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole or nitrofurantoin for uncomplicated cystitis (3-7 days). Ciprofloxacin for pyelonephritis (7-14 days). IV antibiotics for severe cases. Treat underlying causes.

emergency_signs_en: signs of shock (rapid pulse, low blood pressure)
conditions.description_en: Peptic ulcers are sores in the lining of the stomach or duodenum. The main causes are Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) bacterial infection (most common in Ethiopia) and NSAID use (aspirin, ibuprofen). H. pylori is very prevalent in Ethiopia due to poor sanitation. Complications include bleeding (most common), perforation (surgical emergency), and gastric outlet obstruction. Stress and spicy food do not cause ulcers but can worsen symptoms.
conditions.description_am: የሆድ ቁስለት ሆድ ወይም ዱዋዴነም ሽፋን ላይ ቁስሎች ናቸው። ዋና ምክንያቱ ሄሊኮባክተር ፒሎሪ ባክቴሪያ ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ሆድ ቁስሊ ኣብ ሆድ ሽፋን ዝፍጠር ቁስሊ እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Eat small, frequent meals. Avoid NSAIDs (aspirin, ibuprofen) — use paracetamol instead. Avoid alcohol and smoking. Reduce spicy and acidic foods. Take antacids for symptom relief. Visit health center for H. pylori testing and triple therapy antibiotics. Do not ignore black stool or blood vomiting.
conditions.self_care_am: ትንሽ ትንሽ ብዙ ጊዜ ይብሉ። አስፕሪን እና ኢቡፕሮፌን ያስወግዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀሊል ምግቢ ብዙሕ ጊዜ ብላዕ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Treat H. pylori infection. Avoid NSAIDs or use with proton pump inhibitor. Avoid alcohol and smoking. Food hygiene to prevent H. pylori transmission.
conditions.treatment_en: H. pylori eradication: triple therapy (omeprazole + amoxicillin + clarithromycin for 14 days). Proton pump inhibitors (omeprazole) for acid suppression. Antacids for symptom relief. Surgery for perforation or obstruction.

conditions.description_en: Epidemic typhus is caused by Rickettsia prowazekii, transmitted by body lice. It occurs in overcrowded, unhygienic conditions — historically associated with wars, famines, and refugee camps. Ethiopia has experienced typhus outbreaks. Murine typhus is transmitted by rat fleas. Scrub typhus by mites. All forms cause high fever, headache, and rash. Untreated, mortality can be 10-40%.
conditions.description_am: ታይፈስ ቅማሎች ወይም ሌሎች ነፍሳት ሲነክሱ ሪኬቲሲያ ባክቴሪያ ሲተላለፍ ይከሰታል።
conditions.description_ti: ታይፈስ ብቅማሎ ዝመሓላለፍ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Visit health center immediately. Delouse clothing and bedding (wash in hot water or use insecticide). Improve hygiene. Isolate patient. Doxycycline is highly effective if started early.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። ልብስ እና አልጋ ሸፈን ያጽዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቀልጢፍካ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Delousing. Improved hygiene and sanitation. Insecticide-treated clothing. Avoid overcrowded conditions.
conditions.treatment_en: Doxycycline 100mg twice daily for 7-10 days. Chloramphenicol as alternative. Supportive care.

symptoms: undulant fever (fever that comes and goes)
conditions.description_en: Brucellosis is caused by Brucella bacteria transmitted from infected animals (cattle, goats, sheep, camels) through raw milk, unpasteurized dairy products, or direct contact with animal tissues. It is common in pastoral communities in Ethiopia. The fever characteristically comes and goes (undulant fever). Chronic brucellosis can cause arthritis, endocarditis, and neurological complications.
conditions.description_am: ብሩሴሎሲስ ከተበከሉ እንስሳት ጥሬ ወተት ወይም ቀጥታ ንክሻ ሲተላለፍ ይከሰታል።
conditions.description_ti: ብሩሴሎሲስ ካብ ዝተበከሉ እንስሳ ዝመሓላለፍ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Boil all milk before drinking. Avoid raw dairy products. Use gloves when handling animal births or carcasses. Visit health center for blood test and antibiotic treatment.
conditions.self_care_am: ወተት ሁሉ ከመጠጣቱ በፊት ያፍሉ። ጥሬ የወተት ምርቶችን ያስወግዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ወተት ቅድሚ ምስታዩ ፍልሕ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Pasteurize or boil milk. Avoid raw dairy. Vaccinate livestock. Use protective equipment when handling animals. Proper disposal of animal products.
conditions.treatment_en: Doxycycline 100mg twice daily + rifampicin 600mg daily for 6 weeks. Or doxycycline + streptomycin for 6 weeks. Longer treatment for complications.

conditions.description_en: Anthrax is caused by Bacillus anthracis spores found in soil and infected animals. Outbreaks occur in Ethiopia, particularly in livestock-keeping areas. Cutaneous anthrax (most common) occurs from handling infected animals or hides. Gastrointestinal anthrax from eating infected meat. Inhalation anthrax is rare but most deadly. Report all suspected cases to health authorities immediately.
conditions.description_am: አንትራክስ ከተበከሉ እንስሳት ወይም ቆዳ ሲነካ ይከሰታል። ሁሉም ጉዳዮች ወዲያውኑ ሪፖርት ይደረጉ።
conditions.description_ti: ኣንትራክስ ካብ ዝተበከሉ እንስሳ ዝፍጠር ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY. Do not eat meat from animals that died suddenly. Report sick or dead animals to veterinary authorities. Do not handle dead animals without protection.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ድንገት ከሞቱ እንስሳት ሥጋ አይብሉ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Vaccinate livestock. Avoid contact with sick or dead animals. Cook meat thoroughly. Report animal deaths. Proper disposal of carcasses.
conditions.treatment_en: Ciprofloxacin or doxycycline for 60 days. Anthrax antitoxin for systemic disease. Penicillin G IV for severe cases. Supportive care.

conditions.description_en: Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. It is emerging in Ethiopia, particularly in urban and lowland areas. There are 4 dengue serotypes — second infection with a different serotype can cause severe dengue (dengue hemorrhagic fever). No specific antiviral treatment exists — management is supportive. Dengue is distinct from malaria but can be confused with it.
conditions.description_am: ዴንጊ ትኩሳት ኤዲስ ትንኝ ሲነክስ ሚተላለፍ የቫይረስ በሽታ ነው። ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ እየጨመረ ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ዴንጊ ብኤዲስ ትንኹ ዝመሓላለፍ ናይ ቫይረስ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Take paracetamol for fever — do NOT take aspirin or ibuprofen (increases bleeding risk). Visit health center for dengue test. Monitor for warning signs of severe dengue. Eliminate mosquito breeding sites (standing water).
conditions.self_care_am: ያርፉ፣ ብዙ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። ፓራሲታሞል ይውሰዱ — አስፕሪን ወይም ኢቡፕሮፌን አይጠቀሙ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ፈሳሲ ስተ። ፓራሲታሞል ውሰድ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Eliminate Aedes mosquito breeding sites (empty standing water containers). Use mosquito repellent. Wear long sleeves. Window screens. Dengue vaccine available in some countries.
conditions.treatment_en: Supportive care: oral rehydration, paracetamol. IV fluids for severe dengue. Platelet transfusion if severe thrombocytopenia with bleeding. No specific antiviral.

conditions.description_en: Hepatitis B is a viral liver infection transmitted through blood, sexual contact, and mother-to-child transmission. Ethiopia has high hepatitis B prevalence (about 7-8% of adults). Chronic hepatitis B can lead to cirrhosis and liver cancer. Most adults clear acute infection; 5-10% develop chronic infection. Infants infected at birth have 90% chance of chronic infection. Hepatitis B vaccine is highly effective and part of Ethiopia's routine immunization schedule.
conditions.description_am: ሄፓቲቲስ ቢ ደም፣ ወሲብ ወይም ከእናት ወደ ልጅ ሊተላለፍ የሚችል የጉበት ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ኢትዮጵያ ከፍተኛ ስርጭት አለ።
conditions.description_ti: ሄፓቲቲስ ቢ ናይ ጉበት ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Get vaccinated — hepatitis B vaccine is free in Ethiopia. Use condoms. Do not share needles, razors, or toothbrushes. Test pregnant women and vaccinate newborns within 24 hours of birth. Visit health center for hepatitis B test and antiviral treatment if chronic.
conditions.self_care_am: ክትባት ይውሰዱ። ኮንዶም ይጠቀሙ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ክታበት ውሰድ። ኮንዶም ተጠቐም። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Hepatitis B vaccination (3-dose series). Birth dose within 24 hours. Safe injection practices. Blood screening. Condom use. PMTCT.
conditions.treatment_en: Acute: supportive care. Chronic: tenofovir or entecavir antiviral therapy. Monitor liver function and AFP for liver cancer. Liver transplant for end-stage disease.

conditions.description_en: Hepatitis A is a viral liver infection spread through contaminated food and water (fecal-oral route). It is common in areas with poor sanitation. Unlike hepatitis B and C, hepatitis A does not cause chronic infection — most people recover fully within 2 months. Rarely, it can cause acute liver failure. Hepatitis A vaccine is available for travelers and high-risk individuals.
conditions.description_am: ሄፓቲቲስ ኤ በተበከለ ምግብ እና ውሃ ሚተላለፍ የጉበት ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ብዙ ሰዎች ሙሉ ለሙሉ ይድናሉ።
conditions.description_ti: ሄፓቲቲስ ኤ ብዝተበከለ ምግብን ማይን ዝመሓላለፍ ናይ ጉበት ቫይረስ ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Rest and drink plenty of fluids. Eat small, frequent, low-fat meals. Avoid alcohol completely. Wash hands thoroughly. Visit health center for liver function tests. Most cases resolve without specific treatment.
conditions.self_care_am: ያርፉ፣ ብዙ ፈሳሽ ይጠጡ። አልኮሆል ሙሉ ለሙሉ ያስወግዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ዕረፍቲ ውሰድ፣ ፈሳሲ ስተ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Safe water and food. Handwashing. Proper sanitation. Hepatitis A vaccine for travelers and high-risk groups.
conditions.treatment_en: Supportive care. Rest. Adequate nutrition. Avoid hepatotoxic drugs and alcohol. Hospitalization for severe cases.

symptoms: swollen hands and feet in infants
emergency_signs_en: acute chest syndrome (chest pain, fever, difficulty breathing)
conditions.description_en: Sickle cell disease (SCD) is an inherited blood disorder where red blood cells become sickle-shaped, causing blockages in blood vessels, pain crises, anemia, and organ damage. It is common in malaria-endemic regions of Africa, including Ethiopia. Sickle cell trait (carrier) provides some protection against malaria. SCD requires lifelong management. Hydroxyurea reduces pain crises. Newborn screening allows early intervention.
conditions.description_am: ሲክል ሴል ህመም ቀይ የደም ሴሎች ሲክል ቅርፅ ሲይዙ ይከሰታል። ህመም ቀውስ፣ የደም ማነስ እና የአካል ጉዳት ያስከትላል።
conditions.description_ti: ሲክል ሴል ሕማም ቀይሕ ደም ሲክል ቅርጺ ዝወስደሉ ዝፍጠር ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Drink plenty of water daily. Avoid extreme cold, heat, and high altitude. Take folic acid daily. Take penicillin prophylaxis as prescribed (for children). Get vaccinated (pneumococcal, meningococcal, influenza). Visit health center regularly. Seek immediate care for fever, severe pain, or difficulty breathing.
conditions.self_care_am: ብዙ ውሃ ይጠጡ። ፎሊክ አሲድ ይውሰዱ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ብዙሕ ማይ ስተ። ፎሊክ ኣሲድ ውሰድ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Genetic counseling for carriers. Newborn screening. Folic acid supplementation. Penicillin prophylaxis in children. Vaccinations. Hydroxyurea therapy.
conditions.treatment_en: Hydroxyurea (reduces crises). Folic acid. Penicillin prophylaxis. Pain management (paracetamol, NSAIDs, opioids for severe pain). Blood transfusion. Bone marrow transplant (curative but limited availability).

conditions.description_en: Pre-eclampsia is a pregnancy complication characterized by high blood pressure (above 140/90) and protein in urine after 20 weeks of pregnancy. It can progress to eclampsia (seizures), HELLP syndrome (liver and blood clotting problems), and maternal/fetal death. It is a leading cause of maternal mortality in Ethiopia. Risk factors include first pregnancy, multiple pregnancy, previous pre-eclampsia, diabetes, and hypertension.
conditions.description_am: ቅድመ ኤክላምፕሲያ ከ20 ሳምንት እርግዝና በኋላ ከፍተኛ የደም ግፊት እና ሽንት ውስጥ ፕሮቲን ያለው ሁኔታ ነው። ሊሞት ሊያደርስ ይችላል።
conditions.description_ti: ቅድሚ ኤክላምፕሲያ ኣብ ምስ ልዑል ጸቕጢ ደም ዝፍጠር ናይ ጥንሲ ሕማም እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY if any warning signs. Attend all antenatal care visits for blood pressure monitoring. Take low-dose aspirin if prescribed for prevention. Rest on left side. Avoid salt. Deliver at health facility.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ሁሉም ቅድመ ወሊድ ጉብኝቶችን ያድርጉ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Regular antenatal care with blood pressure monitoring. Low-dose aspirin (75-150mg) from 12 weeks for high-risk women. Calcium supplementation. Deliver at health facility.
conditions.treatment_en: Antihypertensives: methyldopa, labetalol, nifedipine. Magnesium sulfate for seizure prevention and treatment. Delivery is the definitive treatment. Corticosteroids for fetal lung maturity if preterm.

emergency_signs_en: any fever in newborn under 2 months
conditions.description_en: Neonatal sepsis is a life-threatening blood infection in newborns (under 28 days). It is a leading cause of neonatal death in Ethiopia. Causes include Group B Streptococcus, E. coli, Klebsiella, and Staphylococcus. Risk factors include premature birth, low birth weight, prolonged rupture of membranes, maternal infection, and unhygienic delivery. Any sick newborn should be treated as a medical emergency.
conditions.description_am: የጨቅላ ህጻን ሴፕሲስ ከ28 ቀን በታች ህጻናት ውስጥ ደም ኢንፌክሽን ነው። ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዋና የጨቅላ ህጻን ሞት ምክንያት ነው።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ሕጻን ሴፕሲስ ኣብ ትሕቲ 28 መዓልቲ ሕጻናት ዝፍጠር ናይ ደም ኢንፌክሽን እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: GO TO HOSPITAL IMMEDIATELY with any sick newborn. Keep newborn warm (skin-to-skin contact). Breastfeed exclusively. Keep umbilical cord clean and dry. Do not apply anything to cord except clean water. Wash hands before handling newborn.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ። ህጻኑን ሞቅ ያለ ቦታ ያቆዩ። ጡት ያጥቡ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ። ሕጻን ሞቕ ዝበለ ቦታ ሓዝ።
conditions.prevention_en: Skilled birth attendance. Clean delivery. Kangaroo mother care for premature babies. Exclusive breastfeeding. Cord care. Maternal GBS screening and treatment. Antenatal care.
conditions.treatment_en: IV ampicillin + gentamicin for 7-10 days. Supportive care: warmth, fluids, oxygen. Treat complications. Kangaroo mother care for premature infants.

conditions.description_en: Fever in children under 5 is one of the most common reasons for health facility visits in Ethiopia. The main causes are malaria, pneumonia, diarrhea, meningitis, and ear infections. The IMCI (Integrated Management of Childhood Illness) approach is used in Ethiopia to assess and treat sick children. Any child with danger signs requires immediate referral. Fever above 38.5C in infants under 3 months is always an emergency.
conditions.description_am: ከ5 ዓመት በታች ህጻናት ትኩሳት ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ለመሄድ ዋና ምክንያት ነው። ዋና ምክንያቶቹ ወባ፣ ሳምባ ምች፣ ተቅማጥ ናቸው።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ቆልዓ ረስኒ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ዝኸዱ ዋና ምኽንያት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Take temperature with thermometer. Give paracetamol (not aspirin) for fever above 38.5C. Dress lightly. Give extra fluids. Continue breastfeeding. Visit health center immediately if: under 3 months with any fever, convulsions, unable to drink, very lethargic, rash with fever, stiff neck.
conditions.self_care_am: ሙቀት ይለኩ። ፓራሲታሞል ይስጡ (አስፕሪን አይደለም)። ብዙ ፈሳሽ ይስጡ። ወዲያውኑ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሙቀት ምዕ። ፓራሲታሞል ሃቢ። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Malaria prevention (bed nets). Vaccination. Breastfeeding. Handwashing. Safe water. Nutrition.
conditions.treatment_en: Treat underlying cause. Paracetamol for fever. ORS for dehydration. Antibiotics for bacterial infections. Antimalarials for malaria. Refer danger signs immediately.

emergency_signs_en: burns covering more than 10% of body
burns on face, hands, feet, genitals, or joints
inhalation injury (singed eyebrows, hoarse voice, soot in mouth)
conditions.description_en: Burns are a major cause of injury and death in Ethiopia, particularly in children due to open cooking fires. First-degree burns affect only the outer skin layer (redness, pain). Second-degree burns cause blisters. Third-degree burns destroy all skin layers (white or charred, painless). Inhalation injury from smoke is life-threatening. Infection is the main complication of burns.
conditions.description_am: ቃጠሎ በኢትዮጵያ ዋና የጉዳት ምክንያት ነው። ህጻናት ከምድጃ ቃጠሎ ይጎዳሉ።
conditions.description_ti: ቃጸሎ ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ዋና ናይ ጉዳት ምኽንያት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Cool the burn immediately with cool (not cold/ice) running water for 20 minutes. Remove jewelry and tight clothing near burn. Cover with clean cloth. Do NOT apply butter, oil, toothpaste, or egg white. Do NOT burst blisters. Give paracetamol for pain. Visit health center for all but very minor burns.
conditions.self_care_am: ቃጠሎውን ወዲያውኑ ለ20 ደቂቃ ቀዝቃዛ ውሃ ያፈሱ። ቅቤ ወይም ዘይት አይጠቀሙ። ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ቃጸሎ ቀልጢፍካ ን20 ደቂቃ ቀዝቃዛ ማይ ኣፍስስ። ቅቤ ኣይጠቐም። ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Keep children away from cooking fires. Use enclosed stoves. Store chemicals safely. Electrical safety. Smoke detectors.
conditions.treatment_en: Cool water irrigation. Wound cleaning. Silver sulfadiazine cream. Tetanus prophylaxis. IV fluids for major burns (Parkland formula). Skin grafting for deep burns. Nutritional support.

emergency_signs_en: signs of internal bleeding (rigid abdomen, shock)
conditions.description_en: Road traffic injuries are a major cause of death and disability in Ethiopia. Ethiopia has one of the highest road traffic fatality rates in Africa. Other common traumas include falls, agricultural injuries, and violence. Head injuries, internal bleeding, and spinal injuries are the most life-threatening. The 'golden hour' concept — definitive care within 1 hour of injury — is critical for survival.
conditions.description_am: የትራፊክ አደጋዎች ኢትዮጵያ ውስጥ ዋና የሞት ምክንያት ናቸው። ወዲያውኑ ሆስፒታል ያስፈልጋል።
conditions.description_ti: ናይ ትራፊክ ሓደጋ ኣብ ኢትዮጵያ ዋና ናይ ሞት ምኽንያት እዩ።
conditions.self_care_en: Call for help immediately. Control bleeding with direct pressure. Do not move patient if spinal injury suspected. Keep airway open. Keep patient warm. Do not give food or water. Transport to hospital as quickly as possible.
conditions.self_care_am: ወዲያውኑ እርዳታ ይጠሩ። ደም መፍሰስ ቀጥታ ጫና ያቁሙ። ሆስፒታል ይሂዱ።
conditions.self_care_ti: ሕጂ ሓገዝ ጸውዕ። ደም ምፍሳስ ቀጥታ ጸቕጢ ኣቋርጽ። ናብ ሆስፒታል ኪድ።
conditions.prevention_en: Wear seatbelts. Helmets for motorcycles. Avoid drunk driving. Road safety education. Speed limits. Safe road design.
conditions.treatment_en: ABCDE approach (Airway, Breathing, Circulation, Disability, Exposure). Control hemorrhage. IV fluids. Blood transfusion. Surgery for internal injuries. Fracture management. Rehabilitation.

health_tips.content_en: Wash hands with soap and clean water for at least 20 seconds before eating, after using the toilet, and after handling animals. Handwashing prevents diarrhea, cholera, and many other diseases.
health_tips.content_am: ከመብላትዎ በፊት፣ መጸዳጃ ቤት ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ እጅዎን ቢያንስ ለ20 ሰከንድ በሳሙና እና ንጹህ ውሃ ይታጠቡ።
health_tips.content_ti: ቅድሚ ምብላዕ፣ ድሕሪ መጸዳዳ ምጥቃም፣ ኣእዳውካ ብሳሙና ን20 ካልኢት ሕጸብ።
health_tips.content_om: Dura nyaachuu, booda mana fincaanii, harka kee saamunaan dhiqadhu.

health_tips.content_en: Sleep under an insecticide-treated bed net every night. Remove standing water near your home. Seek treatment immediately if you have fever.
health_tips.content_am: በየሌሊቱ በፀረ-ነፍሳት ሕክምና ስር ባለ አልጋ መረብ ስር ይተኙ። ከቤትዎ አቅራቢያ ያለ ያቆረ ውሃ ያስወግዱ።
health_tips.content_ti: ኩሉ ለይቲ ኣብ ትሕቲ ናይ ፀረ-ነፍሳት ሸራ ደቅስ። ረስኒ እንተሃልዩካ ቀልጢፍካ ሕክምና ደሊ።
health_tips.content_om: Halkan hunda jalatti huccuu ittisa waraabessaa jala ciisi.

health_tips.content_en: Pregnant women should attend at least 4 antenatal care visits. Take iron and folic acid supplements. Deliver at a health facility with a skilled birth attendant.
health_tips.content_am: እርጉዝ ሴቶች ቢያንስ 4 ቅድመ ወሊድ እንክብካቤ ጉብኝቶችን ማድረግ አለባቸው። ብረት እና ፎሊክ አሲድ ተጨማሪዎችን ይውሰዱ።
health_tips.content_ti: ነፍሰ-ጾር ኣንስቲ 4 ናይ ቅድሚ ሕርሲ ምብጻሕ ክገብራ ኣለወን። ሓጺን ፎሊክ ኣሲድን ውሰዲ።
health_tips.content_om: Dubartoonni ulfaa yoo xiqqaate 4 daawwachuu qabu.

health_tips.content_en: Ensure your child receives all vaccines on schedule: BCG, Polio, DPT, Measles, and others. Vaccines prevent deadly diseases.
health_tips.content_am: ልጅዎ ሁሉንም ክትባቶች በጊዜ ሰሌዳ መሰረት ማግኘቱን ያረጋግጡ። ክትባቶች ገዳይ በሽታዎችን ይከላከላሉ።
health_tips.content_ti: ቆልዓኻ ኩሎም ክታበታት ብሰዓቱ ከምዝረክብ ኣረጋግጽ።
health_tips.content_om: Daa'imni kee talaallii hunda yeroon akka argatu mirkaneessi.

health_tips.content_en: Always drink boiled or treated water. Store water in clean, covered containers. Do not defecate near water sources.
health_tips.content_am: ሁልጊዜ የተፈላ ወይም የታከመ ውሃ ይጠጡ። ውሃን በንጹህ፣ በተሸፈኑ ዕቃዎች ውስጥ ያስቀምጡ።
health_tips.content_ti: ኩሉ ጊዜ ዝፈልሐ ወይ ዝተሓከመ ማይ ስተ።

health_tips.content_en: Eat a variety of foods including grains (teff, maize), legumes (lentils, beans), vegetables, and fruits. Breastfeed infants exclusively for the first 6 months.
health_tips.content_am: እህሎችን (ጤፍ፣ በቆሎ)፣ ጥራጥሬዎችን (ምስር፣ ባቄላ)፣ አትክልቶችን እና ፍራፍሬዎችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ምግቦችን ይብሉ።
health_tips.content_ti: ዝተፈላለዩ ምግቢ ብላዕ — ጣፍ፣ ቆሎ፣ ምስር፣ ባቄላ፣ ኣሕምልቲ።

health_tips.content_en: Cover your mouth when coughing. Ensure good ventilation in your home. If you cough for more than 2 weeks, visit a health center for TB testing.
health_tips.content_am: ሲያስሉ አፍዎን ይሸፍኑ። ቤትዎ ጥሩ አየር እንዲኖረው ያድርጉ። ከ2 ሳምንት በላይ ሳል ካለ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ።
health_tips.content_ti: ክትስዕዕ ኣፍካ ሸፍን። ልዕሊ 2 ሰሙን ሳዕዓል እንተሃልዩካ ናብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ኪድ።

health_tips.content_en: Always deliver at a health facility with a trained birth attendant. Prepare a birth plan and emergency transport. Danger signs: heavy bleeding, convulsions, prolonged labor.
health_tips.content_am: ሁልጊዜ በሰለጠነ ሰው ዘንድ ወደ ጤና ጣቢያ ይሂዱ። የወሊድ እቅድ ያዘጋጁ። አደጋ ምልክቶች: ከፍተኛ ደም፣ ሽብርታ፣ ረዥም ወሊድ።
health_tips.content_ti: ኩሉ ጊዜ ኣብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ምስ ሰልጢኑ ሰብ ሕርሲ ግበሪ።

health_tips.content_en: Use condoms consistently. Get tested for HIV at your health center. Pregnant women should get tested to prevent mother-to-child transmission.
health_tips.content_am: ኮንዶም ያለማቋረጥ ይጠቀሙ። በጤና ጣቢያ ለኤች አይ ቪ ይመርምሩ። እርጉዝ ሴቶች ከእናት ወደ ልጅ ስርጭትን ለመከላከል ይመርምሩ።
health_tips.content_ti: ኮንዶም ኩሉ ጊዜ ተጠቐም። ኣብ ጥዕና ጣቢያ ምርመራ ግበር።

health_tips.content_en: Mental health is as important as physical health. Talk to someone you trust if you feel sad, anxious, or overwhelmed. Health extension workers can provide support.
health_tips.content_am: የአዕምሮ ጤና እንደ አካላዊ ጤና ጠቃሚ ነው። ሀዘን፣ ጭንቀት ወይም ጫና ከተሰማዎ ለሚያምኑት ሰው ይናገሩ።
health_tips.content_ti: ናይ ኣእምሮ ጥዕና ከም ናይ ኣካላት ጥዕና ኣገዳሲ እዩ።
health_tips.content_om: Fayyaan sammuu akka fayyaa qaamaa barbaachisaa dha.
